channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Apocalypter
item.description: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

item.title: Island Restoration
item.description: Island Restoration is a cleaning game where you heal a scarred world, one island at a time. Clean up hazards, rescue cute animals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools as you explore diverse regions and transform ever-changing islands into beautiful paradises.

item.title: Necrophosis
item.description: Necrophosis is a first-person horror adventure, plunging you into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Delve into eerie landscapes and uncover secrets in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

item.title: Otterly Lost
item.description: Swim, dive, and explore as a curious sea otter far from home. Meet charming animals, discover hidden places, use tools, and solve light challenges as you make your way back with your favorite rock by your side.

item.title: Plan B: Terraform
item.description: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water, and forests.

item.title: Plan B: Terraform - Worlds of Fire and Water
item.description: Discover a harsh and dangerous volcanic planet, plagued by constant eruptions and extreme heat. Then dive into a fully oceanic world where only a handful of tiny islands await your industry. It's up to you to transform these hostile worlds into new paradises.

item.title: REAL WEB LEGENDS: Carter's Quest
item.description: Fight for your life in a SCANDALOUS fantasy world where anything is possible. With a devilish combat system, outrageous characters, and set-pieces galore; you never know what's next in REAL WEB LEGENDS: Carter's Quest.

item.title: Shadow Warrior 2
item.description: Shadow Warrior 2 is the stunning evolution of Flying Wild Hog’s offbeat first-person shooter starring the brash warrior Lo Wang, who must again wield a devastating combination of guns, blades, magic and wit to strike down the demonic legions overwhelming the world.

item.title: Slow Roads
item.description: Zone out on an endless drive through infinite scenic landscapes. Generate a unique world, set the scene to suit your mood, and just drive...

item.title: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
item.description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

item.title: Bunker Tidy Up
item.description: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,437 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

item.title: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
item.description: A story-driven Metroidvania where the allies you choose to bond with change how you fight and explore. Journey through the high-fantasy world of Raoah, uncover lost civilizations, and forge bonds that shape your path through a land on the brink of collapse.

item.title: FluxWerks
item.description: Every block of this planet is real, including fluids! Dig it, flood it, process it. FluxWerks is a factory automation game on a fully destructible voxel world with physical fluid and heat simulation. Dig anywhere, automate everything, and survey a world that was supposed to be empty.

item.title: It's Fine
item.description: Idle / Incremental about developing a game with your dog Joe. Unlock unique mechanics, evolve with multi-layered prestige, find secrets, beat all alt endings, and deliver your game on time!

item.title: Heroes' Vow: Three Kingdoms
item.description: This Three Kingdoms sandbox RPG lets you do whatever you wish in the late Han Dynasty. Be a ruler, courtier, or hermit. Make friends, marry, raise children, manage estates, train yourself & allies, govern, drill troops, experience & alter history, and conquer all to win the hearts of the people.

item.title: The Piper of Dawn
item.description: Welcome to Diamond City, a realm trapped in an endless cycle of madness! This story-rich dark fantasy sim lets you master alchemy, grow magical crops, run a thriving shop, and build relationships with humans and non-humans alike. Discover the city's many fates through your choices.

item.title: Graveyard Keeper - Game Of Crone
item.description: In the second storyline DLC you’ll help the escaped prisoners of the Inquisition survive in the wilderness, develop their camp to a fortified settlement and protect them from a sinister enemy. But whether you unravel the mystery of the cruel game, which put the whole world into chaos?

item.title: Dying Light: The Beast - Discharge Weapon Pack
item.description: Embrace the storm with Discharge, an electrifying machete salvaged from the heart of Harran. Designed as a tool of destruction, its charged blade crackles with untamed energy, cleaving through the Infected with a visceral thrill.
